units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13">Lev. R. s. 13</cite> <he>אברהם ראה</he> … <he>בעִיסּוּקָן</he> Abraham (in his vision, <cite ref="Genesis 15:9">Gen. XV, 9</cite> sq.) beheld the empires typically represented by their doings (policy).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:18">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>צא שעה אחת לעִיסּוּקוֹ</he> deduct one hour for the work of preparing the sacrifice; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 5:1:2">Y. Pes. V, 31ᶜ</cite>, sq.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 5:4:7">Y. Sabb. V, end, 7ᶜ</cite> <he>שור שעיסוקו רע</he> an ox hard to manage.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:2:4">Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מצות ע׳ מדידה</he> the law demanding the act of measuring (even if there be no doubt as to the nearest place, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:2">Deut. XXI, 2</cite>); (Bab. ib. 45ᵃ; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 14b:1">Snh. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>לַעֲסוֹק במדידה</he>).
